evidenceLocations: PDF page containing section 'Placement & Higher Studies', table e3, UG [4 Years Program(s)], row for first-year intake 2020-21; graduating academic year 2023-24: 990 graduated in minimum stipulated time, 731 placed, median salary INR 1,961,000 per annum.
PDF lines 111-124 (table headings) and 151-160 (2023-24 outcome row) in the text extraction.

value.cohort: UG [4 Years Program(s)] graduates in minimum stipulated time, graduating academic year 2023-24
value.definition: Count placed among students graduating in minimum stipulated time, as reported in the institution-submitted NIRF 2025 data. This aggregate is not a placement rate and does not identify individual degrees.
